Two focused projects

From provider protocols
to native app experiences.

AIReasoningCore

THE APP INTEGRATION LAYER

A Swift package that connects AnyLanguageModel’s LanguageModel and LanguageModelSession APIs to pi-ai-swift. It maps prompts, transcripts, tools, generation options, usage, and provider assets into a session interface for native apps.

View AIReasoningCore on GitHub ↗

pi-ai-swift

THE PROVIDER RUNTIME

A native Swift semantic port of the provider runtime in pi’s AI package. Its small ProviderRuntime interface covers model discovery, authorization, and streaming responses, with provider-specific request encoding, event normalization, and usage reporting underneath.

Use it independently, or pair it with AIReasoningCore when your app needs the AnyLanguageModel session interface.

View pi-ai-swift on GitHub ↗

Integration interest

Bring ChatGPT identity to native apps.

We’re seeking an official Sign in with ChatGPT integration for pi-ai-swift and apps built with AIReasoningCore, so users can sign in with their ChatGPT identity and, when eligible, use their ChatGPT plan for AI requests.
